p.s: As far as I am concerned, I think young people enjoy life more than seniors do.
There are two reasons to support this idea - health, and society.
First, young people are passionate and healthy.
Since they are healthier than older peole, they can more travel or do activites than older people do.
Older people get easily tired and need the rest, because of that, it takes much more time for seniors to travel or do activites while healthy young people do much more activities.
Also there are many activites that require a good health such as sky diving, soccer, and so on.
Since these activities are difficult for old people, they cannot do or enjoy these activities even though they really want to do those.
So there are many limitations to older people.
However, many young people with a great tenacity can enjoy aggresive activities and can do in a long period of time.
The other reason that young people can enjoy life more than older people do is society.
In society, there are many businesses making many entertainments.
The problem is that their targets are mostly young people, teenagers or ages of twenty to forty.
The reason is young people usually make money, however old people usually retired from their jobs and became unemployed.
For example, movie theaters, or amsement parks are usually noisy and are packed with a huge number of people which are the exact conditions that many old people do not like.
By time goes by, many companies emerges to the society and they produce many entertainments for young people, not old people.
Therefore, there are getting less things to enjoy for old people.
Some people may think that older people and young people equally have chances to enjoy their lives.

However, due to the fact that young people are healthier and more make money and society does not care for older people in entertaiments field, I think young people are likely to live in enjoyable lives.
